title: Sem Loses His Purple Color!
description: Sem accidentally washes off Saf's purple pen ink... and tries to put it back 😱 #ThePenFamily #Shorts
thumbnail_prompt: Sem (green pen, tiny) holding an empty purple ink bottle looking terrified. Saf (purple pen) in background looking horrified. Bright bathroom background. No text.

beats.text: Uh oh. Uh oh. UH OH!
What did you DO?!
I was just helping!
My color is GONE! I'm invisible!
Wait — Saf is literally transparent?
I can fix it! I got a pwan!
Nobody touch anything. Family meeting!
Wait — where does pen color even come from?
Son... what exactly did you wash?
The purple stuff. It was dirty!
That IS her. That's literally Saf's color.
I thought it was paint!
I AM the paint! I AM THE PURPLE!
Puh-puh!
She's fine. Color comes back. Deep breaths.
How do you know that?!
Because Sem did this to Oz last Tuesday.
We agreed we weren't talking about that.
I'm sowwy Saf. I didn't know.
...okay. But next time ASK first. Why though?
